scenes.notes: Spout 9 m = 990 px, YOU 1.75 m = 192.5 px, 5 stacked = 962 px (shared pxPerM 110). Raw "9 M" shown, not said.
Turnstile: "should be easy, it's a baby" (41-44%), cute and calm, broken on the next word.
Calf: BlueWhale pxPerM 30 (draws 7 m at the scene scale of 120 px/m = 840 px); YOU pxPerM 120 (210 px). 35-icon CountGrid.
Peak. 230-icon CountGrid (23x10, 44x62 px icons) fills the top row by row; Balance levels on "side", re-tips on "tomorrow".
